description: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.
terms.label: molecular entity

description: A chemical entity is a physical entity of interest in chemistry including molecular entities, parts thereof, and chemical substances.
terms.label: chemical entity

description: A molecular entity that contains no carbon.
terms.label: inorganic molecular entity

description: A molecular entity having a net electric charge.
terms.label: ion

description: A monoatomic entity is a molecular entity consisting of a single atom.
terms.label: monoatomic entity

description: A nucleus is the positively charged central portion of an atom, excluding the orbital electrons.
terms.label: atomic nucleus

description: A molecular entity all atoms of which have the same atomic number.
terms.label: elemental molecular entity

description: A molecular entity containing one or more atoms from any of groups 1, 2, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18 of the periodic table.
terms.label: main group molecular entity

description: An s-block molecular entity is a molecular entity containing one or more atoms of an s-block element.
terms.label: s-block molecular entity

description: A particle smaller than an atom.
terms.label: subatomic particle

description: A nucleus or any of its constituents in any of their energy states.
terms.label: nuclear particle

description: A monoatomic or polyatomic species having one or more elementary charges of the proton.
terms.label: cation

description: An atom or small molecule with a positive charge that does not contain carbon in covalent linkage, with a valency of one.
terms.label: monovalent inorganic cation
